title: Web Foundations: The First Campfire
tagline: Build your first real website with a crew that cheers for you.
description: We start with the basics—HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript—then turn them into something you’re proud to ship. It’s gentle, practical, and community-led.
experience: Weekly build-alongs that feel like co-working
Office hours where questions are welcomed
A final demo night with kind feedback
outcomes: Publish a personal site or portfolio
Make small UI features without fear
Learn a repeatable build workflow

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: This chapter is for beginners who want momentum. We focus on fundamentals that unlock the rest of the web—without the overwhelm.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll learn by building in small steps, with a mentor-guided rhythm. Every week ends with something working.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: By the end, you’ll have a live project and the confidence to keep going.

title: React Systems: Building with Intent
tagline: Turn components into a product story.
description: We build a small product front-end with React, focusing on clarity: routing, state, and UI patterns that scale.
experience: A guided build that ships in increments
Design reviews that are constructive
Pairing sessions when you get stuck
outcomes: Ship a multi-page React app
Write reusable UI components
Understand app structure and routing

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: This chapter is about building with intention. We’ll keep the UI simple and make the structure strong.

chapterSections.title: What participants will experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll practice shipping in small slices: one route, one feature, one decision at a time.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with a complete, navigable app and a blueprint you can reuse.

title: Mentorship Sprint: From Idea to Demo
tagline: A short sprint to turn a tiny idea into a real demo.
description: A fast-paced, supportive sprint for participants who want to practice shipping. Bring an idea (or borrow one) and build alongside mentors.
experience: A kickoff that clarifies scope
Mid-sprint check-ins to unblock you
A final demo night with reflections
outcomes: Ship a demo you can show
Learn how to break work down
Practice receiving feedback

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: This chapter is a sprint, not a marathon. We optimize for learning through shipping.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll make tradeoffs, build the smallest valuable thing, and learn fast.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with a demo and a clearer sense of your process.

title: Open Source Onramp: Issues to Impact
tagline: Learn the rhythm of contributing—without the guesswork.
description: A guided, low-pressure onramp to open source. We’ll practice reading projects, choosing issues, making small pull requests, and communicating clearly with maintainers.
experience: A weekly cadence: read → attempt → ask → ship
PR walkthroughs that make Git feel normal
Templates for respectful, confident communication
outcomes: Make at least one merged contribution
Build confidence navigating unfamiliar code
Learn how to ask for help effectively

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: We focus on the process, not perfection. Small contributions compound into real impact.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll practice the full loop: finding an issue, making a change, opening a PR, and responding to review.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with a repeatable approach to contributing and a clearer mental model of how projects work.

title: Backend API Lab: From Routes to Reliability
tagline: Build a small API that’s predictable, testable, and kind to users.
description: We build a simple REST API and learn the habits that keep it stable: clear contracts, validation, error handling, and lightweight testing.
experience: Short lessons followed by hands-on implementation
Examples of real-world edge cases
A final demo where reliability is part of the story
outcomes: Ship an API with predictable responses
Write a small test suite that earns trust
Understand the tradeoffs of common API patterns

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: We keep the scope small so the quality can be high. Reliability is a skill you can practice.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll build routes, then harden them: validate inputs, design errors, and test the behavior.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with a backend project you can explain, maintain, and extend.

title: Data Handbook: Practical Analytics for Builders
tagline: From messy questions to clean signals.
description: A beginner-friendly chapter on working with data in a practical way: defining metrics, shaping datasets, and telling a truthful story with charts.
experience: Metric design exercises that clarify thinking
Hands-on data cleaning with simple tools
Story-first reporting: what matters and why
outcomes: Create a small analytics report you can share
Learn how to avoid misleading charts
Build comfort working with imperfect data

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: Data work is mostly careful thinking. We’ll practice asking better questions before we touch a chart.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll define metrics, clean a small dataset, and publish a short report with clear conclusions.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with a repeatable workflow for turning questions into signals.

title: Career Clinic: Portfolio and Interview Fundamentals
tagline: Practical prep that keeps your voice intact.
description: A short clinic for early-career builders: clarify your story, refine a portfolio, and practice interviews with structured, kind feedback.
experience: Portfolio teardown sessions (supportive, specific)
Mock interviews with actionable feedback
Narrative coaching for introductions and project stories
outcomes: Improve your portfolio narrative
Practice interviews in a low-stakes setting
Leave with a clear next-step plan

chapterSections.title: Introduction
chapterSections.content: We focus on clarity and confidence. Your story should feel honest and easy to repeat.

chapterSections.title: What you’ll experience
chapterSections.content: You’ll iterate on your portfolio and practice interview reps with feedback you can use immediately.

chapterSections.title: Skills & outcomes
chapterSections.content: You’ll leave with sharper materials and more comfort speaking about your work.
